acquisition method: confirm a subset of these SAAV to reference peptide ratios by parallel reaction monitoring (PRM)
alkylation reagent: followed by 5 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) at 37°C for 30 min

cleavage agent: following proteolytic digestion using two separate proteases (i.e., Trypsin and LysC)

ionization type: equipped with a nanoelectrospray ion source
